guardGroups.reason: clock: channel.go:116, 142. Comparing effective deadline against the live clock. Inspection: sample before/equal keeps the resource, later discards.
dynamic-state: channel.go:110, 190. Readiness includes concurrent send and receive, including unbuffered rendezvous. Inspection: ready chooses the channel case, unavailable chooses default.
external-call: channel.go:83, 124, 154, 212, 220, 241. Boolean return tests are separately proven. Actual cleanup, health, blocking and panic contracts are external.
